title: Find which Arch package owns a specific file
summary: Use pkgfile to search the official Arch repositories and find out which package provides a specific file. This is useful when you see a 'command not found' error or need to know which package to install to get a specific library or binary.

aliases.text: which package owns this file arch
arch linux find package by file
найти пакет по имени файла pkgfile

prerequisites: The pkgfile database is up to date

steps.explain: Update the pkgfile database to ensure it knows about the latest packages in the repositories.
Search for the package that owns the specific file you are looking for.

placeholders.name: FILENAME
placeholders.description: The name or path of the file you want to find the owner of.

alternatives.explain: Search only within the bin or sbin directories (useful for executables).
Search and display the package version.
